claim_one_line: THE DIRECTION IS THE MASS MATRIX (sealed 0bbbb6cab; PROVED -- every cell holds as sealed): in the unitary frame (R/|R|, conj(R)/|R|, n) fixed by tau, a Higgs in M couples by Y(a) = 0 on R and the complex symmetric M2(a) = [[2 a.conj(R), |R| a.n], [|R| a.n, -a.R]] from span(conj R, n) to span(R, n), det M2 = -|R|^2 (a.a); a -> M2 is a linear bijection onto the symmetric 2x2 matrices, so the Higgs's direction carries the two massive generations' whole mass matrix and the coupling predicts only the massless generation along R(tau) and the block's symmetry; s1 s2 = |R|^2 |a.a|; a potential symmetric under SO(3) on M and a phase puts the minimum on the isotropic cone (m = 0) or the real locus (m >= 1/2), never between, and the zero modes' loop changes only the |a.a|^2 coefficient near the cone; the quaternion units as directions give m >= 1/2 (exactly 1/2 for e_k on tau = iy, by Jacobi) -- so nothing on the record fixes the direction, and a small non-zero m2/m3 is a free number per sector.  [Scoped by frame at S124 (2026-10-14): a result in Lambda's frame, the fibre at one tau. In the audit lane's E8 embedding the Higgs in M is a Standard Model singlet, a flavon (the web seat's condensate test, its parity step verified in B1650; the audit lane's field map), so its reading as the electroweak Higgs needs the parent map (P-108).] [Audited by main (P-152, B1655, 2026-10-15): 'never between' holds for a quartic potential: one octic invariant, or the zero modes' own one-loop term, puts minima between the cone and the real locus (the audit's check, reproduced on main: B1655 verification/check_potential.py); only real units were tested as vacua; 'nothing on the record fixes the direction' leaves the SM seat's cusp reading (P-113, isotropic eigenlines) unexamined] 0 of 19.
